reportTitle: RailPath India — Railway Distance Data Audit & Normalization Quality Report

phase1AuditCurrentDataset.rootCause: Raw DataMeet schedules.json lacks a distance column on stop rows; scripts/buildNationwideTimetable.cjs only populated km=0 at origin (stop 0) and km=properties.distance at the final destination stop, leaving all 90,578 intermediate stops as km=null.

phase2And3CandidateDatasetEvaluations.reason: Every single stop record in prasenjit-27/Indian-Railway-Data trains.json has "distance": 0 (0 out of 416,637 stops have distance > 0), failing Phase 3 monotonicity and overallDistanceKm consistency checks.

phase2And3CandidateDatasetEvaluations.license: None (license: null on GitHub; academic paper citation dataset)
phase2And3CandidateDatasetEvaluations.reason: Contains high-quality stop distances (99.79% monotonic), but repository has no open-source license file (license: null). Excluded from redistribution to strictly honor licensing rules.

phase2And3CandidateDatasetEvaluations.upstreamSource: Government of India Open Government Data Platform (data.gov.in) — Ministry of Railways All-India Train Timetable Dataset
phase2And3CandidateDatasetEvaluations.license: MIT License (repository) / Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India)
phase2And3CandidateDatasetEvaluations.reason: Legitimately reusable under MIT License & GODL-India, covers all 18 railway zones (99.16% station code match with Railway_stations.json), and provides verified integer cumulative stop distances from train origin.
